speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: Hello there, how are you?

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: Hi

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: How much do you know about Save the Children?

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: I know that it is a charity.  I think I have seen some commercials for it in my lifetime.

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: Were you aware that Save the Children assists both children in the U.S. as well as foreign countries?

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: No.  I figured they just tried to help children in under developed countries.  That's great that they help people in the U.S. as well!  I think it's important to help children from our country and also others.

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: Yes, not only do we help out with literacy and school related causes, but also with feeding, shelter, and disaster relief for children all over the world.

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: That's wonderful!  Are you a top rated charity?  How much goes to administrative costs?

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: We are a top rated charity, and have been around for nearly 100 years! Nearly 90% of our funds go straight to children, with the remainder going to fundraising costs and only 5% for admin costs.

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: Wow!  That's really great!  I've seen companies go to 70% and I can't help but judge them for it.  I think this is a fair percentage to have.

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: We try our best to keep the children first, and have done so in aiding millions of children over the years.

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: I think that's great!  What country is in the most need right now?

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: Both Africa and USA currently have the highest number of children in need.

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: That's sad that a country as powerful as the USA still has problems with children in need.

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: It is very sad, but with the help of so many millions of caring people we are able to enrich the lives of so many.

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: What is the money used for mostly?  Food?  Toys?  Clothes?  I think this is all very interesting stuff.  I've never had the chance to talk to a charity before.

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: Monies go to sustain the lives of children in environments in which basic necessities are lacking. For example,Syrian children have grown up facing the daily threat of violence. In the first two months of 2018 alone, 1,000 children were reportedly killed or injured in intensifying violence.

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: That's terrible.  I hope this kind of environment changes for them.  Children deserve to be in a safe place and to feel secure.

speaker: A2581F7TDPAMBQ
text: Well, each day children are able to get such needs met by the generosity of those even with donations as small as the cost of about $1 a day. A little goes such a long way!

speaker: A29VL3MZE7YPBZ
text: I can imagine!  I hope lots of people donate to you.  I bet it's especially good around Christmas when people are in the spirit of giving.
